clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath the Moonshrine Ruins, the Fathom Core records the elements at work in Blackfathom Deeps. The Earthen Ring seeks it to learn how the Twilight's Hammer is manipulating those forces.

The Fathom Core rests inside an ancient fathom stone beneath the Moonshrine Ruins. It records shifts, disruptions, and surges in the elements over time. Je'neu Sancrea, an Earthen Ring shaman at Zoram'gar Outpost, seeks the core to understand how the Twilight's Hammer cultists are turning the region's elements to their own ends.
